summary: Together AI Startup Accelerator is a selection-based program, not a general signup grant. Approved startups receive up to $15K, $30K, or $50K in free platform credits depending on funding stage (Build: up to $5M raised / Scale: $5–10M raised / Grow: over $10M raised). Credits can be used for serverless inference, dedicated endpoints, fine-tuning, and instant clusters, but do not apply to Reserved GPU Clusters.
claim_steps: Confirm your startup is building an AI-native application.
Apply at together.ai/startup-accelerator (no card required to apply).

If selected, credits are granted according to funding tier: Build (up to $5M raised), up to $15K; Scale ($5–10M raised), up to $30K; Grow (over $10M raised), up to $50K. Credits do not apply to Reserved GPU Clusters.
